description: Repairs r-ado-1b/batch-scope-group: both adAffectGroup attempts failed while a row 3 edit was pending and with a string Filter, so the two causes were not separated. This probe has no pending edit and varies only the Filter kind. On a client static batch-optimistic recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID (read-write copy of r-ado-1b-main): S of rows 1, 2 and 3 set to "g1", "g2", "g3", each posted with Update (EditMode read), Errors read and cleared; Filter = "ID <= 2" (Filter, RecordCount); UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) with Errors read and cleared right after; the stored rows through Execute; Filter none; Filter = "ID > 99" (RecordCount) and UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) with Errors read right after; Filter none and UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) with Errors; the stored rows through Execute. Asks whether adAffectGroup accepts a string Filter, which rows it submits, and how an empty string group answers.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
